ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOD = 84^\circ$, $\angle AOB = 18^\circ$, and OB bisects $\angle AOC$. What is the measure of $\angle COD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $OB$ bisects $\angle AOC$, and $\angle AOB=18^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=2\angle AOB=36^\circ$,\\
Also, given that $\angle AOD=84^\circ$,\\
it results in $\angle COD=\angle AOD-\angle AOC=84^\circ-36^\circ=\boxed{48^\circ}$.
